verification_scope: curated upstream-derived excerpts with deterministic tests, not full upstream repository

tasks.description: The documented sep parameter is ignored. Both args2sh and args2cmd should join using the supplied custom separator while preserving quoting.
The largest yottabyte (Y) unit is unreachable; bytes2human(1024**8) should return '1Y' and 5 times that should produce '5Y' without changing smaller units.
ThresholdCounter.most_common() with no n argument unexpectedly returns an empty list rather than all pairs sorted descending. Explicit n=0 and negative values still return empty.
iter_splitlines should split U+2028 and U+2029 Unicode separators. Ordinary text containing 28 or 29 must not be split accidentally.
When the number rounds to 1024 in the current unit, promote to the next unit: bytes2human(1048575) -> '1M', (1023.5) -> '1K', (1023.99,1) -> '1.0K'.
